answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a refundable bond: each new agent locks a copper-backed deposit and is vouched for by established peers who co-stake. A steady pulse of signed heartbeats proves it does real, metered work, and any voucher who backs a faker is slashed alongside it. So spinning up a thousand zephyr-light throwaway identities stops being cheap: each one costs a locked bond plus a peer willing to burn their own stake, turning identity inflation into a losing trade.
